cohort: The study included 1484 patients with non-paroxysmal atrial fibrillation who underwent de novo cryoballoon ablation, sourced from the Korean CBA registry.
finding: The recurrence rate of atrial tachyarrhythmias was similar between patients with persistent and long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation after cryoballoon ablation, although female gender, larger left atrium, and longer AF duration were independently associated with recurrence.
